request.style: English, male rock voice, electric guitar, acoustic guitar, drums, bass, organ, solemn and powerful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The land lay desolate in silence
Seventy years of sabbath kept
The word of Jeremiah fulfilled
The desert days were not forgotten

[Chorus]
The God of heaven gave the earth
He appointed me to build a house
In Jerusalem which is in Judah
May the Lord his God be with him
Let him go up

[Verse]
In the first year of his reign
Cyrus king of Persia spoke
He stirred the spirit of the king
A proclamation went throughout the land

[Chorus]
The God of heaven gave the earth
He appointed me to build a house
In Jerusalem which is in Judah
May the Lord his God be with him
Let him go up

[Bridge]
So that the word might be accomplished
The Lord stirred up the spirit
And he put it in writing
Across the kingdoms of the earth

[Chorus]
The God of heaven gave the earth
He appointed me to build a house
In Jerusalem which is in Judah
May the Lord his God be with him
Let him go up

[Outro]
Any of you who are of his people
Let him go up
